title: 第5章 神乎其技定缺三针第6章 谁拜谁的师
slug: 大罗邪仙苟在剑门当药师
content_zh:
“是！钟大儒请随晚辈进来！”圣子躬身。
后面的门打开，十名弟子静静地躺在里面。
旁边还站着一堆的长老，这些长老，要么是这些天骄的师父，要么是他们的父母亲，全都忧心如焚。
钟成逐一检查。
所有人心头全都提得老高。
包括圣子，也包括大长老……
他们想通过钟成的脸色看出有没有点希望，但是，钟成脸上没有任何表情，这让他们心里完全没底。
丹田破裂，是修者最害怕的事情。
一旦破裂，除非遇到某种特殊的机缘，几乎无法重修。
这十人之中，有没有点希望？
不说十个全都救回，救一个也行啊……
钟成立于最后一名弟子身边，目光缓缓抬起：“丹田破裂，修行绝症，寻常之法定然无效，唯一的一线生机，系于‘定缺三针’。”
西门大考全身大震，眼睛猛然亮起：“请钟大儒施针！”
“请钟大儒施针！”后面，所有长老一齐躬身。
“好！”钟成手一伸，指尖出现了一根长长的银针。
银针一出，一股浩然正气弥漫于针尖之上，昏暗的内堂，纤毫毕现，这一针，在空中划过一道玄妙至极的轨迹，插在这名弟子的丹田处。
这名弟子眼睛猛然睁大，身子一躬，慢慢放平，就此倒下。
第二针，第二名弟子……
第三针！
第六针！

钟大儒额头已然隐隐有汗光。
圣子轻声道：“钟大儒，要不要休息下再施第七针？”
钟成轻轻摇头：“无妨，老朽还可以！”
后面，又是连续三针！
三针下去，他终于坚持不住，身子一软，圣子赶紧扶住。
钟成苍白的脸上露出了笑容：“大长老，不妨检查下第一个扎针的弟子，或许真有奇效！”
大长老一步上前，一指点在最末尾那个弟子的丹田处，他的眉毛突然急剧颤抖：“丹田在修复！速度非常快！”
此言一出，满堂大哗！
唰地一声，每个受伤的弟子面前都出现了一位顶级长老，一轮检测，所有人，十位弟子，破裂的丹田，全都在修复！
圣子西门大考一躬到地：“钟大儒妙手回春，神乎其技，晚辈拜谢！”
整个医堂完全轰动……
圣女峰上！
西门二丝、西门三丝面面相觑。
“医堂那边传来欢呼！”西门三丝道：“难道……”
“不用猜，我已然远程探测到，这位杏林圣手以定缺三针，完全治好了十位弟子！”西门二丝头发一振，空中飞来一根微不可察的秀发。
content_en:
"Yes! Zhong Daru, please come in with this junior!" The Holy Son bowed.
The door at the back opened, and ten disciples lay quietly inside.
There were a bunch of elders standing next to them. These elders were either the masters of these talented people or their parents, and they were all worried.
Zhong Cheng checked them one by one.
Everyone's heart is high.
Including the Holy Son, including the Great Elder...
They wanted to see if there was any hope through Zhong Cheng's face, but there was no expression on Zhong Cheng's face, which made them feel completely unsure.
A rupture of the Dantian is what practitioners fear most.
Once it breaks, it is almost impossible to repair it unless you encounter some special opportunity.
Is there any hope among these ten people?
Not to mention saving all ten, just one...
Zhong Cheng stood next to the last disciple and slowly raised his eyes: "The Dantian is broken and the cultivation is terminal. The ordinary methods are obviously ineffective. The only glimmer of hope lies in the 'Three Needles to Define Deficiency'."
Ximen Dakao was shocked all over, and his eyes suddenly lit up: "Please ask Zhong Daru for acupuncture!"
"Please give Zhong Daru acupuncture!" Behind him, all the elders bowed together.
"Okay!" Zhong Cheng stretched out his hand, and a long silver needle appeared on his fingertips.
As soon as the silver needle came out, an awe-inspiring righteousness filled the tip of the needle, and every detail of the dim inner hall appeared. The needle traced a mysterious trajectory in the air and was inserted into the disciple's dantian.
The disciple's eyes suddenly opened wide, his body bowed, slowly leveled, and fell down.
The second shot, the second disciple...
The third shot!
The sixth shot!
There was already a faint sheen of sweat on Zhong Daru's forehead.
The Holy Son said softly: "Zhong Daru, do you want to rest before applying the seventh injection?"
Zhong Cheng shook his head gently: "It doesn't matter, I'm still okay!"
Later, there were three more stitches in a row!
After three injections, he finally couldn't hold on any longer and his body went limp. The Holy Son quickly held him back.
A smile appeared on Zhong Cheng's pale face: "Great Elder, you might as well check the first disciple who received the acupuncture. Maybe it will have a miraculous effect!"
The great elder stepped forward and pointed at the Dantian of the last disciple. His eyebrows suddenly trembled sharply: "The Dantian is repairing! It's very fast!"
As soon as this statement came out, the whole hall was in an uproar!
With a snap, a top elder appeared in front of each injured disciple. After a round of testing, everyone, including ten disciples, were repairing the broken Dantian!
The Holy Son Ximen Da Kao bowed to the ground: "Zhong Daru's wonderful hand has rejuvenated, and his skills are miraculous. Thank you, junior!"
The whole hospital was in a complete sensation...
On the Saintess Peak!
Ximen Ersi and Ximen Sansi looked at each other.
"There are cheers from the medical hall!" Ximen Sansi said: "Could it be..."
"No need to guess, I have already detected remotely that this Xinglin sage has completely cured ten disciples by fixing the missing three needles!" Ximen Ersi's hair trembled, and an undetectable hair flew in the air.
